item.title: Letters to The Sun: Choosing permanent daylight time over standard time is a mistake
item.description: Re: B.C. makes daylight time permanent after years of promises Stopping the twice-annual time change is excellent policy, but choosing permanent daylight time instead of permanent standard time is a mistake. The human body clock and many bodily functions are synchronized by natural light and darkness and correlate with bright sunlight in the morning and […]
